entities.name: UE Capabilities Transfer
entities.description: Procedure for transferring UE radio access capabilities from UE to network.

entities.name: UE Capability Information
entities.description: Message sent by UE to provide its radio access capabilities to the network.

entities.name: UECapabilityEnquiry
entities.description: Message sent by network to request UE radio access capabilities.

entities.name: UE radio access capability information
entities.description: Information element containing UE's supported radio access technologies and features.

relations.description: Procedure includes network sending UECapabilityEnquiry message to request UE capabilities.
Procedure includes UE sending UE Capability Information message in response to enquiry.
UE Capability Information message contains UE radio access capability information IE.
